Hi Nora —

Attaching version 3 of the MAP (redwood_map_v3.xlsx) and the initial cutover runbook draft. We're tracking to a target go-live on Sept 9 (US PST). This note pulls together the final acceptance checklist and the explicit rollback/fallback triggers we discussed. Can you confirm the acceptance window below and the operations owners on your side?

Summary (asks to confirm):
- Acceptance window: Sept 9, 10:00–14:00 PST (30m verification after traffic shift).
- Success criteria: error rate < 0.5% over 10m, 95th percentile latency < 450ms, and synthetic eval pass on the core prompt set (attached).
- Rollback triggers: >1% sustained error rate for 5m OR two successive failed synthetic eval runs.
- Fallback plan: automatic route to B0 model variant + traffic cap to 25% while we remediate.

Owners (Redwood):
- Cutover lead: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com)
- Runbook & rollback automation: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com)
- Customer success / comms: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)

Owners (Novamed): please confirm Ops lead and Procurement sign-off owner.

I've also added a short rehearsal runbook step at the top of cutover_runbook_v1.md — recommend a 60m rehearsal with a staged traffic shift two business days before (Sept 7).

If this all looks good, I'll circulate a calendar hold with the runbook and invite Red/Novamed Tech Ops for the rehearsal.

Thanks,
